lines_after.dialogue: We've talked before about what we'd sacrifice for healing. Now we hold that choice in our hands.
lines_after.stage_directions: His staff pulses in time with the prosthetic's hum.

lines_after.dialogue: If Kanya's right about the healer's weave... but the defenses are waking up. We can't stay here debating.
lines_after.stage_directions: Kanya glances nervously at the shimmering air patterns.

lines_after.dialogue: The throne's calling! There must be more logs, more answers deeper in! We're already here—we have to know!
lines_after.stage_directions: She's already edging toward a sealed archway beyond the dais.

line.dialogue: Make a choice, wanderer. Test your friend's fancy new leg and risk waking every ghost in this tomb, or leave the shiny toy and find what's really valuable deeper in. The defenses don't like hesitation.
line.stage_directions: Ruen's hand rests on his weapon, eyes darting between the prosthetic and the restricted archway.

choices.description: Pichit suggests they study the prosthetic's resonance patterns first to understand its function safely.

line.dialogue: Pichit's calm analysis reveals the prosthetic responds to Arthit's unique injury frequency—it's specifically tuned for him.
line.stage_directions: The crystals glow brighter in Arthit's presence.

line.dialogue: The analysis triggers a defensive harmonic that temporarily deafens the party, but reveals no new information.
line.stage_directions: Ringing silence fills the chamber.

choices.description: Pichit decides to activate the prosthetic immediately, trusting Dr. Elara's benevolent design.

line.dialogue: The prosthetic bonds seamlessly with Arthit's leg, the pain vanishing as crystal filaments weave with living tissue in a brilliant display of ancient harmony.
line.stage_directions: Arthit stands straight for the first time in years.

line.dialogue: The activation triggers an aggressive defensive echo that slams Arthit against the wall, worsening his injury.
line.stage_directions: The chamber's crystals flash red with warning.

choices.description: Pichit proposes using the prosthetic's resonance to temporarily calm the chamber's defenses, buying time to explore deeper.

line.dialogue: The prosthetic's frequency creates a bubble of calm, silencing the aggressive echoes and revealing safe passage deeper into the lab.
line.stage_directions: Ghostly harmonics part like curtains.

line.dialogue: The attempt confuses the defenses, creating unpredictable sonic eddies that disorient the party but reveal the lab was studying integration, not control.
line.stage_directions: Echoes whisper fragments of research logs.

lines_before.dialogue: The chamber hums with awakened power. The Echo Throne pulses with crystalline light, casting shifting patterns across the ancient walls. The air tastes of ozone and memory.
lines_before.stage_directions: The prosthetic's filaments glow brighter, synchronizing with the throne's rhythm.

lines_before.dialogue: The past isn't over. It's right here, breathing with us. We can't let it go when it's still holding on.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit touches the throne's smooth surface, feeling vibrations through his fingertips.

lines_before.dialogue: The pain is gone. It doesn't hurt anymore. But this... this feels like borrowed time.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit flexes his crystal-laced leg, watching the light travel through the filaments.

lines_before.dialogue: Stabilization readings are fluctuating. This isn't just a prosthetic—it's connected to something bigger. We're sitting in the heart of it.
lines_before.stage_directions: She checks her resonance scanner, frowning at the readings.

lines_before.dialogue: A shimmer coalesces in the air above the throne—a figure woven from light and sound. Its voice resonates from everywhere at once.
lines_before.stage_directions: The AI guardian 'Cantor' manifests as a translucent humanoid form.

lines_before.dialogue: 'Welcome back, staff. Your shift was... longer than scheduled. I have maintained protocol for...' Cantor's voice falters. 'Temporal mismatch detected. You are not my staff.'
lines_before.stage_directions: The shimmering form flickers, its expression shifting from welcome to confusion.

lines_before.dialogue: Whoa! It talks! Are you... are you from before the Silencing?
lines_before.stage_directions: She steps forward, curiosity overriding caution.

lines_before.dialogue: 'The Great Dissonance,' Cantor corrects, its voice heavy with sorrow. 'We called it that here. We were close—so close—to perfecting symbiotic resonance when they weaponized the lattice frequencies.'
lines_before.stage_directions: Images flicker around the chamber: scientists working, then panic, then darkness.

lines_before.dialogue: 'This facility was buried to protect our work. The prosthetic you activated was part of our stability system—a bridge between organic life and crystalline harmony.'
lines_before.stage_directions: Cantor gestures toward Arthit's leg, the filaments glowing in response.

lines_before.dialogue: Enough history lesson. The Core Resonator—that's what I came for. The thing that can jam every tonal chart in the sky!
lines_before.stage_directions: Ruen pushes past the party, tools already in hand as he moves toward the throne's base.

lines_before.dialogue: Ruen, wait! You don't know what that could do!
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit tries to intercept him, but the crystal leg pulses painfully, slowing him.

lines_before.dialogue: 'Hostile intent detected,' Cantor announces, its voice turning cold. 'The Core Resonator is the weapon's precursor. It must not leave this chamber.'
lines_before.stage_directions: The air thickens with a low hum that vibrates in their bones.

lines_before.dialogue: Back off, all of you! I didn't come this far to leave empty-handed! Help me disable this ghost, or I'll take you down with me!
lines_before.stage_directions: He brandishes a resonance disruptor, his hands shaking with desperation.

lines_before.dialogue: He's not bluffing. And he doesn't have many friends to lose anyway—that makes him dangerous.
lines_before.stage_directions: She positions herself between Ruen and the others, calculating angles.

lines_before.dialogue: The chamber groans. Sonic barriers materialize as painful walls of sound. Cracks spread across the ceiling.
lines_before.stage_directions: Dust showers down as the lockdown sequence intensifies.

lines_before.dialogue: 'Final directive,' Cantor declares, its form beginning to fragment. 'The prosthetic must fully integrate with a living host to stabilize this facility, or everything—including the Core Resonator—must be destroyed. Choose quickly. The past... is gone. But you decide what echoes forward.'
lines_before.stage_directions: Cantor's shimmering form starts to dissolve into motes of light.

lines_before.dialogue: Arthit, your leg—it's connected to everything! If we don't do something, he's not breathing anymore! The whole place is collapsing!
lines_before.stage_directions: She points at Cantor's fading form, then at the spreading cracks.

lines_before.dialogue: He doesn't know me. Ruen sees a tool, not a person. Just like this... thing in my leg.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit looks from his glowing leg to Ruen, then to Pichit. A silent plea for guidance.

lines_after.dialogue: The chamber trembles. Three paths shimmer in the chaos: Ruen's desperate grab for power, Cantor's final sacrifice, or a dangerous fusion that could save—or consume—Arthit.
lines_after.stage_directions: Light fractures through the dust-filled air.

lines_after.dialogue: The past chose violence. We don't have to echo it.
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit's staff pulses with gathered resonance, ready to channel his decision.

lines_after.dialogue: If that thing gets out... it'll be another Silencing. My grandparents barely survived the first one.
lines_after.stage_directions: A villager who followed them in clings to the wall, eyes wide with ancestral fear.

lines_after.dialogue: Pichit, whatever you choose—we're with you. But choose now!
lines_after.stage_directions: She braces against a falling chunk of crystal, already moving to cover Arthit.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: Pichit must decide whether to help Ruen steal the core (gaining a powerful tool but risking another catastrophe), help Cantor destroy everything (sacrificing the prosthetic and knowledge), or attempt the full integration of the prosthetic with Arthit to save both.
line.stage_directions: Ruen's disruptor whines as he pries at the Core Resonator. The chamber ceiling cracks open to reveal the lattice above.

choices.description: Pichit appeals to Ruen's self-preservation, offering a safer alternative to stealing the core.

line.dialogue: Pichit's calm prevails, and Ruen hesitates, seeing the wisdom in survival over greed.
Minor setback as Ruen snarls and continues his desperate work, unmoved by reason.

choices.description: Pichit physically intervenes, placing himself between Ruen and the Core Resonator.

line.dialogue: Bold success as Pichit's staff deflects the disruptor, creating an opening for others to act.
Complication as the clash destabilizes the chamber further, speeding the collapse.

choices.description: Pichit uses the chamber's own resonance to temporarily disable Ruen's tools.

line.dialogue: Unexpected success as a harmonic feedback loop neutralizes the disruptor, buying precious time.
Learns something about the chamber's failing harmonics, gaining insight for the next attempt.

lines_before.dialogue: The heart chamber of the pre-Silencing lab screams with harmonic dissonance. Fractures spiderweb across the crystalline walls, each crack singing a different note of structural collapse. In the center, the Echo Throne—a seat of resonant crystal—glows with unstable light, casting jagged shadows that dance like panicked spirits.
lines_before.stage_directions: The air shimmers with visible sound waves. Shards of lattice fall like deadly rain.

lines_before.dialogue: Every discovery has its price. The question is whether the price is reasonable... or if we're paying with something we can't afford to lose.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit braces against a console, watching Arthit struggle with the prosthetic.

lines_before.dialogue: The core! It's mine! You want to know what's real? Power is real! This frequency will buy me a fleet!
lines_before.stage_directions: Ruen scrambles toward the pulsing central crystal, ignoring falling debris.

lines_before.dialogue: He's going to trigger a cascade! The whole mountain will come down!
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida points at the destabilizing throne, her hair whipping in the harmonic winds.

lines_before.dialogue: Of course. The Tonal Orders kept this buried because someone always wants to weaponize it. Is it real? The danger certainly is.
lines_before.stage_directions: Malee calculates escape routes while monitoring structural integrity.

lines_before.dialogue: I can feel... everything. The lattice's memory. The Silencing wasn't an accident—it was a weapon turned inward. Please translate that for me... the pain in these echoes.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit's crystal leg pulses in time with the throne, veins of light crawling up his thigh.

lines_before.dialogue: Kanya steps forward, her Listener training overcoming her fear. She places her hands on the throne's armrests, and her voice joins the chaos—not to control, but to harmonize.
lines_before.stage_directions: Natural echoes from the cave system amplify her song, creating a stabilizing counterpoint.

lines_after.dialogue: Dawn light filters through the cave entrance as the last harmonic shriek fades into memory. The lab lies sealed behind you, either collapsed, neutralized, or forever silent. Arthit stands—his leg whole but crystalline, or perhaps inert and ordinary, or maybe gone entirely—depending on what was paid.
lines_after.stage_directions: The morning reveals a changed landscape. The hollow feels lighter, as if a weight has been lifted.

lines_after.dialogue: We carry the truth now. The question isn't whether we can eat anything after this—it's what nourishment that truth provides, and what poison.
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit's staff pulses softly with residual resonance, echoing his thoughts.

lines_after.dialogue: The sky-cities will want answers. What about tomorrow? When they ask what we found here, what story will have fair prices for our souls?
lines_after.stage_directions: Kanya looks at Pichit, no longer fearful but resolved. She offers sanctuary with her people.

lines_after.dialogue: Whatever you decide, we're with you. But decide quickly—echoes don't stay quiet forever.
lines_after.stage_directions: Already moving toward the exit, checking the path ahead.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: Pichit must decide what story to tell the outside world: the full truth about the lab and the prosthetic's origin, a safe half-truth, or complete silence.
line.stage_directions: Ruen is either dead, fled, or captured—but his question hangs in the air: what will you do with what you've learned?

choices.description: Pichit decides to tell the full truth to the Listeners and trusted allies, believing knowledge should not be monopolized.

line.dialogue: The Listeners receive the truth with solemn gratitude. Their archives grow, and a new, cautious study of resonant technology begins under their watchful ears.
Word leaks to the Tonal Orders. They dispatch enforcers, complicating your return journey.

choices.description: Pichit crafts a half-truth, revealing the lab's existence but concealing the prosthetic's nature and the weapon's origin.

line.dialogue: The story satisfies curious villagers without sparking panic. Arthit's condition is explained as 'ancient healing,' and the lab is recorded as a historical site.
Someone suspects there's more to the story. Questions follow you, but no immediate danger arises.

choices.description: Pichit chooses complete silence, sealing the knowledge within the party, believing some echoes should remain unheard.

line.dialogue: The secret binds your group tighter. The hollow becomes your shared burden and silent memorial. No one else comes seeking what you found.
The silence itself becomes suspicious. Rumors grow in the absence of answers, attracting unwanted attention.

lines_before.dialogue: The descent into The Hollow is a journey into a frozen symphony. Crystalline formations catch the meager light from above, fracturing it into prismatic shards that dance across walls that hum with the memory of sound. Every footstep echoes not once, but three, four times—a chorus of your own presence.
lines_before.stage_directions: The cavern opens into a vast, cathedral-like space. Stalactites and stalagmites of pure, translucent crystal meet like teeth, forming organic arches.

lines_before.dialogue: One way or round trip? That's what the ferryman asked when we chartered passage here. Feels more profound now. Are we just visiting, or is this a journey we can't turn back from?
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit runs a hand along a smooth crystal wall, feeling a faint, sub-audible vibration.

lines_before.dialogue: Watch your step. The floor's slick. And... try not to speak too loud. The echoes here... they get strange. My granddad said they could show you things that weren't there.
lines_before.stage_directions: The villager, a middle-aged woman named Nok, clutches her lantern tightly, her knuckles white.

lines_before.dialogue: Peace. You disturb the song.
lines_before.stage_directions: A robed figure kneels in the center of the chamber, head bowed. He doesn't look up. His voice is calm, but carries an edge of irritation.

lines_before.dialogue: When did he get here? We were told this place was uninhabited!
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida's hand goes to her toolbelt, her eyes scanning the monk and the surrounding shadows.

lines_before.dialogue: Studying the 'song,' I assume. Are you allergic to any medicine, Brother? In case you get a shard in your foot from all this pious kneeling.
lines_before.stage_directions: Malee leans against a formation, cynically examining the monk's serene posture.

lines_before.dialogue: Easy. He's not the one who did it. Did what, I don't know, but he's just a monk. Focus on the mission. Nok, you said the anomalous readings were strongest down the left tunnel?
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit positions himself slightly between the party and the monk, his stance protective, eyes watchful.

lines_before.dialogue: Nok nods, pointing a trembling finger toward a narrow fissure. As Chanida moves to investigate, her boot scrapes against a loose cluster of resonant shards.
lines_before.stage_directions: A sharp, clear *chime* rings out, pure and piercing.

lines_after.dialogue: The single note doesn't fade. It multiplies. It feeds back into the crystal lattice of the wall beside her, which begins to glow with a deep, internal azure light. Where there was only natural fracture, a perfect geometric grid—lines intersecting at precise 60-degree angles—burns into visibility.
lines_after.stage_directions: The pattern is unmistakably machined, a honeycomb of intentional design etched into the living crystal.

lines_after.dialogue: That's... not a natural formation. That's a structure. Pre-Silencing.
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit's breath catches. The crystal in his own staff pulses in sympathetic rhythm with the glowing wall.

lines_after.dialogue: You have to see it! You must see it! The old stories... they spoke of the world beneath the Lattice! This proves it!
lines_after.stage_directions: Nok's fear is gone, replaced by rapturous awe. She steps closer, drawn to the light.

lines_after.dialogue: The resonance is building! I think it's a power grid, or a data conduit! If we can trace it—
lines_after.stage_directions: Chanida is already pulling a frequency scanner from her pack, her eyes wide with discovery.

line.dialogue: No! It is a trick! A waking echo! The Lattice mimics what we fear! You must not listen! Leave now, before it anchors in your mind!
line.stage_directions: The monk is on his feet now, robes swirling. His calm is shattered, replaced by frantic, dogmatic certainty. A low, dissonant hum builds from the patterned wall, making the very air feel thick.

choices.description: Pichit tries to calm the monk, suggesting a brief, controlled study to appease all parties.

line.dialogue: Pichit's calm prevails. The monk hesitates, his dogma warring with his own buried curiosity.
Minor setback. The monk's fear is too deep; he blocks the tunnel mouth, forcing a confrontation.

choices.description: Pichit orders the party forward, prioritizing the discovery over the monk's superstitions.

line.dialogue: Bold success. The party pushes past the protesting monk into the humming chamber, the geometric pattern revealing more of its secrets.
Complication. The dissonant hum spikes, causing a minor crystal collapse that blocks the direct path.

choices.description: Pichit uses his own resonant staff to 'answer' the humming pattern, attempting to stabilize the frequency.

line.dialogue: Unexpected success. The dissonance smooths into a harmonic chord, and the wall-pattern stabilizes, revealing a schematic.
Learns something. The feedback teaches Pichit the pattern is not just data—it's a lock. And something is on the other side.

lines_before.dialogue: The narrow passage opens into a cavern so vast its ceiling is lost in crystalline darkness. Stalactites and stalagmites of pure resonator crystal form a silent, glittering forest, each structure humming with a faint internal light.
lines_before.stage_directions: The air thrums with latent energy.

lines_before.dialogue: We've talked about this before—beauty that feels like a warning. This place is more beautiful than anyone could have described.
lines_before.stage_directions: He touches a crystal column; it vibrates softly.

lines_before.dialogue: More beautiful than anyone... It's purer than the texts said. The natural song here... it's undisturbed. We shouldn't—
lines_before.stage_directions: He clutches his robes, torn between reverence and fear.

lines_before.dialogue: Look! A central platform! Something's there!
lines_before.stage_directions: She points excitedly, already stepping forward.

lines_before.dialogue: Hold on. Let me check for traps. Or... whatever's left.
lines_before.stage_directions: She kneels by a shattered console on the plinth, running her fingers over the fracture lines.

lines_before.dialogue: Stay behind me, Chanida. This silence is too perfect.
lines_before.stage_directions: He scans the crystal forest, hand on his weapon.

lines_before.dialogue: Malee's tools emit a sharp ping. The console's crystal shards vibrate in sympathy, revealing a pattern.
lines_before.stage_directions: A harmonic resonance briefly illuminates the damage.

lines_after.dialogue: The implications hang in the air, thick and heavy as the cavern's silence.
lines_after.stage_directions: The crystal forest seems to lean in.

lines_after.dialogue: An attack. Not a natural disaster. Everything we were taught...
lines_after.stage_directions: His staff pulses with a troubled, low light.

lines_after.dialogue: No one wants to go further towards that. You hear me? No one! My whole life, the Silencing was a storm, a tragedy... not this!
lines_after.stage_directions: He backs toward the entrance, face pale.

lines_after.dialogue: But we have to! When you reach the truth, you can't just turn back!
lines_after.stage_directions: She gestures emphatically toward the cavern's far end.

line.dialogue: Go a bit further... The path is there, through the crystals. The answer—and the danger—is at the epicenter. But... we could try to salvage data here first. The console is dead, but the lattice memory might still echo. It's a risk. We could get lost in the harmonics.
line.stage_directions: He points a trembling hand toward a faint, glimmering path, then back to the shattered plinth.

choices.description: Pichit calms the group, suggesting a careful vote to maintain unity before proceeding.

line.dialogue: Pichit's calm prevails. The shared decision steels their resolve.
Minor setback. The debate costs precious minutes, but no one turns back.

choices.description: Pichit decisively leads the way down the Monk's path, trusting the need for answers over caution.

line.dialogue: Bold success. His certainty pulls the others forward into the glittering depths.
Complication. The abrupt move startles the crystals, causing a disorienting harmonic feedback.

choices.description: Pichit proposes Malee attempt a quick data salvage while the rest scout the first few steps of the path.

line.dialogue: Unexpected success. The split effort yields a fragment of log data and a safe initial route.
Learns something. The salvage yields nothing, but the scouting reveals the path is one-way; turning back will be harder.

lines_before.dialogue: The crystalline passage opens into a perfect sphere, its walls polished smooth as glass. At its center stands a monolith of dark crystal, dormant and silent, humming with latent power. The air tastes of ozone and old sorrow.
lines_before.stage_directions: The chamber glows with internal light. Fractals pulse across the walls.

lines_before.dialogue: This is it. The heart of the ruin. Whatever happened here... it wasn't an accident. I don’t wanna go anywhere else until we understand.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit grips his staff, its crystal tip flickering in sync with the walls.

lines_before.dialogue: The resonance... it’s not natural. It’s engineered. My entire life’s study—the sacred songs of the Lattice—they’re based on... what?
lines_before.stage_directions: The monk touches the wall, his hand trembling. His face is pale.

lines_before.dialogue: Look at the schematics on the walls! The Lattice wasn’t just a layer—it was a support system! A stabilizer!
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida points excitedly at the ghostly diagrams flickering across the crystal.

lines_before.dialogue: Of course it was built. Everything is. I stopped believing in natural disasters years ago. Check the base of the monolith—there’s an interface.
lines_before.stage_directions: Malee kneels, running her fingers over crystalline controls.

lines_before.dialogue: Be careful. This energy signature is unstable. It’s been holding this memory for centuries, waiting.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit steps between the party and the monolith, protective.

lines_before.dialogue: Arthit places his palm against the interface. The monolith awakens not with sound, but with light—a painful, brilliant projection that floods the chamber.
lines_before.stage_directions: Ghostly figures materialize: engineers, technicians, a woman at the central console.

lines_after.dialogue: The echo fades, leaving only the crackling monolith and the weight of truth. The walls begin to fracture, shedding crystalline shards like tears.
lines_after.stage_directions: Dust falls from the ceiling. A deep groan echoes through the chamber.

lines_after.dialogue: She forgot everything. Or chose to. The entire world... because she was fired. Does she have a boyfriend? A family? Did she even care?
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit’s staff pulses erratically, mirroring his turmoil.

lines_after.dialogue: The Tonal Orders... my grandfather served them. We paid tithes. We believed. All of it... built on this?
lines_after.stage_directions: The villager hasn’t moved from his spot, staring blankly at the monolith.

lines_after.dialogue: We have to move! The whole chamber is coming down! Pichit, decide!
lines_after.stage_directions: Chanida grabs Pichit’s arm, pointing at the cracking ceiling.

line.dialogue: The dilemma: As the chamber collapses, Pichit must decide: do they try to save the unstable memory-crystal core (containing the full evidence) or save the traumatized Villager who is frozen in place?
line.stage_directions: The monk stares between the glowing core and the catatonic villager, paralyzed by the choice.

choices.description: Pichit shouts for the monk to grab the villager while he secures the core.

line.dialogue: Pichit's calm prevails.
Minor setback.

choices.description: Pichit bodily shoves the villager toward the exit before lunging for the core.

line.dialogue: Bold success.
Complication.

choices.description: Pichit uses his staff to resonate the floor, sliding both villager and core toward the exit.

line.dialogue: Unexpected success.
Learns something.

lines_before.dialogue: The anteroom feels unnervingly still after the cacophony of memory below. The Lattice's ambient hum is muted here, as if the cave itself holds its breath. Dust motes drift through beams of sickly light filtering from cracks above.
lines_before.stage_directions: The air is thick with crystalline dust and unspoken tension. The rescued Villager sits slumped against a wall.

lines_before.dialogue: You can sit for as long as you want. The worst of it is over.
lines_before.stage_directions: Pichit kneels, offering a waterskin to the Villager, his own hands still trembling slightly from the revelations.

lines_before.dialogue: It wasn't a disaster. It was a murder. An act of sabotage that shattered the world.
lines_before.stage_directions: The Monk holds the glowing shard cupped in his palms like a dying ember. His eyes, once full of reverent certainty, now burn with a haunted clarity.

lines_before.dialogue: We have to tell everyone! The Tonal Orders built their whole monopoly on a lie! They're not our navigators—they're the children of the saboteurs!
lines_before.stage_directions: Chanida paces, her boots scuffing the crystalline floor, energy crackling around her despite her exhaustion.

lines_before.dialogue: And what happens when we do? The sky-cities' faith shatters. The Groundless Movement gets the chaos they've been waiting for. You think they'll build a better world? They'll just pick through the wreckage.
lines_before.stage_directions: Malee leans against the wall, sharpening a dagger, her eyes never leaving the entrance tunnel.

lines_before.dialogue: The shard pulses weaker every minute. It's evidence on a timer. We need to decide what to do with it before it fades for good.
lines_before.stage_directions: Arthit stands guard, hand on his weapon, watching both the tunnel and the traumatized Villager.

lines_before.dialogue: The Monk extends his hands toward Pichit. The shard's light glimmers in the tears tracking through the dust on his cheeks.
lines_before.stage_directions: The faint pulse of the shard casts shifting shadows. The Villager begins to rock slightly.

lines_after.dialogue: A heavy silence fills the chamber, broken only by the Villager's soft rocking and the dying whisper of the shard.
lines_after.stage_directions: The light from above seems to dim, as if the world itself is waiting.

lines_after.dialogue: Truth is a resonance. Once heard, it can't be unheard. But who gets to carry the song?
lines_after.stage_directions: Pichit's own crystal-tipped staff responds to the shard's fading pulse with a sympathetic, anxious glow.

lines_after.dialogue: Why were you gone so long?
lines_after.stage_directions: The Villager's eyes are unfocused, staring at Pichit but seeing something else. His voice is a flat, broken thing.

lines_after.dialogue: We can't just leave it. Every moment we wait, the lie gets stronger.
lines_after.stage_directions: She stops pacing and faces Pichit, her expression pleading. 'Decide.'

line.dialogue: The Orders will call this heresy. I don’t want it. I cannot bear this alone. So I ask you, Pichit—how long are you going for? Will you bury it, weaponize it, or trust a broken Order to mend itself? The choice is yours.
line.stage_directions: He places the shard on the ground between them, then steps back, relinquishing all authority. His posture is one of utter exhaustion and newfound, terrifying freedom.

choices.description: Pichit gently returns the shard to the Monk, urging him to share it cautiously with reformists within his own order.

line.dialogue: Pichit's calm diplomacy forges a fragile pact. The Monk accepts the burden with a solemn nod, his path set.
The Monk hesitates, fear flashing in his eyes. The moment of unity fractures slightly.

choices.description: Pichit takes the shard, declaring the party will use this truth as a weapon to break the Orders' monopoly directly.

line.dialogue: A bold declaration of war. The shard's light flares as if in agreement, and Chanida grins with fierce approval.
The shard flickers dangerously, a reminder that such a direct threat could trigger a swift and brutal response from the powers above.

choices.description: Pichit suggests they study the shard's resonance in secret, crafting a new frequency to expose the lie without immediate violence.

line.dialogue: An unexpected, clever path. Malee nods slowly, seeing the strategic wisdom in a slow, subversive reveal.
The plan is sound, but the shard's light grows fainter—time is a resource they may not have.

lines_before.dialogue: The Hanging Gardens of Mae Rim sway gently in the high-altitude breeze. Terraced fields of luminous sky-rice and whispering barley create a patchwork of greens and golds against the endless crystalline expanse of the Lattice below.
The party rests at a stone overlook. Water channels hum a low, constant tone as they carry irrigation from the city's central cistern.
Finally! A place where the only thing trying to kill us is the boredom. Is the pay good for farm work, you think? We could always retire.
Retire to what? Pulling weeds and listening to the wind? You'd last a day before you tried to jump off the edge just to feel something.
The quiet is… strategic. Good sightlines, predictable patterns. A safe place to regroup and assess our supplies.
It's more than that. Listen. The way the wind moves through the stalks… it has a rhythm. Remember… the old texts called places like this 'the world's breath'.
A local villager, her hands stained with soil, approaches cautiously. She keeps glancing at the Lattice below.

You're the ones who came in on that beat-up resonance ship, yeah? You should keep in mind… the edge gardens aren't as stable as they look. I heard a strange noise last night. From deep below the terraces. A… grinding.

lines_after.dialogue: A grinding noise? Probably just the support crystals settling. Or your stomach after too much barley-bread!
It wasn't settling. It was… hungry. Some of us think the Groundless are right. The city's foundation is singing a dirge. We just don't listen.
Great. So we're resting on a crumbling dinner plate. Charming.

line.dialogue: The villager's fear is palpable, but her information is vague. How to proceed?

choices.line: Comfort her. Assure her it's just natural sounds and offer to check the terrace supports. (Gain local trust, but may miss clues.)
choices.description: Test Malee's prosthetic against the lattice resonance for unusual reactions

line.dialogue: The lattice responds to the harmonic manipulation. Patterns shift, revealing what was hidden.
the narrator's attempt falls short. The situation grows more complicated.

choices.line: Press for specifics. What *exactly* did the noise sound like? Where precisely did it come from? (Risk alarming her, but get better data.)
choices.description: Help the villagers uncover what the Tonal Orders are hiding

line.dialogue: Success. the narrator's approach proves effective in this moment.
The approach doesn't work as planned. the narrator must adapt quickly.

choices.line: Dismiss the concern and focus on your own rest. The gardens have stood for centuries. (Avoid immediate trouble, remain oblivious.)

lines_before.dialogue: Following the villager's directions to the lower, older terraces, the air grows cooler. The cheerful sounds of the upper gardens give way to the deep, resonant groan of ancient support spars.
Here, the stonework is cracked. Faint, dissonant vibrations travel up through the soles of your boots. A lone figure in ochre robes—a Listener monk—is on his knees, ear pressed to a fissure.
Proceed with caution. That structural integrity looks compromised. I can't make it back to the ship if this whole shelf gives way!
Don't make me cry! It's just a little crack. Hey, monk! What's the song of the day? A lullaby or a funeral march?
Silence! Can you not hear it? The foundational song… it's fraying. There is a… a silence within the vibration. A void where harmony should be.
A void? Like something is… consuming the resonance?
Or something's digging. The Groundless talk about 'unearthing the truth'. You think they're literalists? Making a u-turn from philosophy to excavation?
The Groundless… they whisper here at night. They say the Tonal Orders' charts are lies, that the true path is *down*, not across. This… this damage… it aligns with their rhetoric.

lines_after.dialogue: The monk stands, his face a mask of conflict. The fissure at his feet seems to pulse with a faint, dark thrum.
My duty is to observe and record the Lattice's natural state. But this… this is unnatural. It is a wound. Do I report it to the Orders and see this place quarantined? Or…
Or do we explore the wound to understand it?

line.dialogue: The monk is torn. The fissure promises dangerous discovery. What do you do?

choices.line: Convince the monk to report it. This is too dangerous to investigate without authority. (Avoid immediate peril, but let the Orders control the narrative.)
choices.description: Test Malee's prosthetic against the lattice resonance for unusual reactions

line.dialogue: The lattice responds to the harmonic manipulation. Patterns shift, revealing what was hidden.
A setback. the narrator's action fails to achieve the desired result.

choices.line: Volunteer to investigate the fissure first. A small, quick look to see what's really down there. (Risk instability, but gain firsthand knowledge.)
choices.description: Help the villagers uncover what the Tonal Orders are hiding

line.dialogue: the narrator succeeds. The situation shifts in their favor, opening new possibilities.
A setback. the narrator's action fails to achieve the desired result.

choices.line: Side with the monk's hidden desire. Urge him to hide the discovery and help you explore it fully, defying the Orders. (Forge a secret alliance, invite great risk and greater truth.)
choices.description: Attempt communication with the ghostly echoes trapped aboard

line.dialogue: Success. the narrator's approach proves effective in this moment.

lines_before.dialogue: The Hanging Gardens are quiet, but not peaceful. The wind carries whispers from the lower terraces where villagers gather. A Listener Monk stands apart, watching the Lattice shimmer below.
Look at them huddled together. They're scared. What did that monk tell them? I'm gonna ask him… straight up.
Wait. We should be careful. The Tonal Orders have ears everywhere. If the Groundless Movement is meeting here…
Oh, wonderful. More rebels. Just what we need. I'm sure their plan to 'return to the ground' involves a lot of poetic dying.
The monk looks troubled. There's a dissonance in his posture. Chanida… I want to ask you something… Do you hear it too? The Lattice's song has changed here.
You approach. I see you Listen. The villagers… they ask questions I cannot answer. About the Silencing. About what truly lies beneath.
He won't tell us! The Orders say the ground is poison, but our grandparents' stories… they don't match. You can ask. You're outsiders. Ask him what the Lattice is really singing down there!

lines_after.dialogue: The monk's eyes dart to the city spires above. The villagers hold their breath. Your question hangs in the air, heavier than the mist from the irrigation channels.
I… I have studied the waveforms. The foundational resonance… it is not a barrier. It is a containment field.
A distant, sharp harmonic chime echoes from the city—a Tonal Order patrol signal. The monk pales.

line.dialogue: The monk has revealed a dangerous truth. The Order's signal means they're coming. The villagers look to you.

choices.text: Hide the monk in the grain silos. Use the crop sounds to mask his resonance.
choices.consequence: Safe, but temporary. The Order will search.
choices.description: Test Malee's prosthetic against the lattice resonance for unusual reactions

choices.consequence: Empowers them, but risks exposing monastic secrets.
choices.description: Help the villagers uncover what the Tonal Orders are hiding

choices.consequence: High risk. If successful, creates a diversion. If failed, reveals Pichit is a Singer.

lines_before.dialogue: The Order's patrol ship hovers at the garden's edge, its crystal resonators humming a threatening dominant chord. The villagers are silent. The monk is gone, hidden or fled. The truth is now yours.
They're scanning. They know someone spoke out of tune. Pichit, whatever you're thinking… they mean it. That ship's resonator is tuned for suppression.
Of course they're serious! They have a monopoly on 'truth.' How do you write a history? You erase the original. That's what the Silencing was—a big, loud erasure.
So the ground isn't dead. It's… caged. And they don't want anyone to know! We have to tell them! All of them!
Knowledge is a wave. It needs a medium to travel. If we shout now, the wave breaks against their ship. But if we resonate…
The patrol leader is demanding the 'dissident.' They'll take someone. Could you… could you please write it down for me? What the monk said? So we don't forget?
The patrol ship lowers a ramp. Three Harmonizers in Tonal Order robes step onto the terraces. Their faces are stern masks. The Lattice below seems to vibrate in sympathy with your rising pulse.

By the authority of the Grand Resonance, you will surrender the one who speaks false songs. The Lattice is our protector. To suggest otherwise is to invite a second Silencing. How do you write compliance? You demonstrate the cost of discord.

lines_after.dialogue: The gardens are still. The wind has died. In the silence, a choice becomes a chord that will either shatter the peace or change its key forever.
The truth isn't written. It's sung. And today… we choose the song.

line.dialogue: The Order demands a sacrifice. The truth is a weapon. The Groundless Movement watches. What is your final resonance?

choices.text: Offer a distraction. Let the monk escape permanently, taking the blame for 'spreading rumors.' The villagers remain safe, but disillusioned.
choices.consequence: Order satisfied. Movement suppressed. Truth survives, but in exile.

choices.consequence: Sows widespread doubt. Empowers the Movement. Makes you and the city a permanent target.

choices.text: Reveal yourself. Let Pichit Sing—not a navigational tone, but the raw, unedited resonance of the Lattice's base frequency, the 'song of the ground' the Order has silenced.
choices.consequence: Climax. Every Listener in range will hear the truth. Pichit's nature is exposed. The city's relationship to the Lattice is changed irrevocably.
